next.reason: 1985: "A RELEASE statement may be used only within the range of an input procedure associated with a SORT statement"; 2023: "may be executed only when it is within the range of an input procedure ... If it is executed at any other time, the EC-FLOW-RELEASE". 1985 states a syntax rule restricting where RELEASE may appear. 2023 makes it an execution-time condition: outside an input procedure, execution sets EC-FLOW-RELEASE.
